anomalies.description: Organic carbon of 0.63 g/kg is critically depleted; soil food web and moisture retention have collapsed, making plant establishment for pollinators extremely difficult.
anomalies.recommended_action: Apply 5 t/ha of well-rotted farmyard manure or biochar immediately; plant a mixed legume-grass cover crop and leave undisturbed for 18 months.

anomalies.description: Drought index of 1.00 (scale 0û1) indicates severe moisture deficit; evapotranspiration is drastically exceeding rainfall over the past 30 days.
anomalies.recommended_action: Activate all available irrigation systems on pollinator habitat areas; report drought conditions to the District Agriculture Officer / KVK for emergency support.

anomalies.description: Only 2 pollinator species observed within 10 km û catastrophic biodiversity collapse. Local extinctions may be underway.
anomalies.recommended_action: Contact State Agriculture Department / Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) to establish a habitat corridor plan; immediately cease mowing all field margins and ditch banks for 12 months to allow recovery.

anomalies.description: Pollinator visitation is reduced to 60% of expected activity (15.1 vs 25.2 visits/hour).
anomalies.recommended_action: Add staggered flowering strips beside the crop edge and pause non-essential sprays during bloom.

anomalies.description: Visitation has fallen by 27% over 12 weeks, suggesting an early decline signal.
anomalies.recommended_action: Repeat fixed-transect pollinator counts for the next 3 weeks and preserve current flowering patches.

anomalies.description: Pollination timing disruption is 0.52; visits may be missing peak flowering windows.
anomalies.recommended_action: Plant early and late flowering margin species to bridge the crop bloom timing gap.

anomalies.description: Flowering success is 42%, below the expected level for a stable crop cycle.
anomalies.recommended_action: Survey flower-to-fruit set across representative rows and add supplemental forage near low-performing rows.

biodiversity_insight: Soil fertility loss is the primary threat, causing plant establishment to fail and reducing pollinator food sources, which will cut crop yields by 20-30% this season.
top_intervention: Add 500 kg/ha of organic compost now to restore soil health and support pollinator-friendly plants.

_meta.crop_dependency_basis: coarse literature-informed estimates, not field-calibrated measurements
